text: Brazil, 2011. A retired bricklayer found a penguin on the rocks, *covered in oil* and close to death. He cleaned him, fed him sardines and set him free. The penguin didn't leave. Months later he finally swam away. Everyone said: that's it. *The next year, he came back.* To the same island. To the same man. Year after year. His name is Dindim. Send this to someone who always comes back.
title: The Penguin Who Keeps Coming Back 🐧❤️
